title: Women's Educational Attainment vs Fertility Rate (2015, Bubble Chart)
description: Bubble chart visualizing the relationship between mean years of education for women (ages 15-64) and fertility rate across countries and regions for 2015. Bubble size represents population. Bubble color encodes world regions according to Our World in Data (OWID).

variables.x: Combined - average years of education for 15-64 years female youth and adults
variables.y: Fertility rate - Sex: all - Age: all - Variant: estimates

author: sonjaweitzing
